1: Jab aasman phat jayega, un farishton ke utarne ki wajah se jo us se utrenge.
2: Jab sitare ek ke baad ek gir kar bikhar jayenge.
3: Jab samandar ek doosre mein khol diye jayenge aur mil jayenge.
4: Jab qabron ki mitti ulat di jayegi, taake un mein jo murde hain woh zinda kiye jayein.
5: Us waqt har jaan jaan legi ke us ne kaise aamaal aage bheje aur kaun se aamaal chhor diye aur na kiye.
6: Aey insan, jis ne apne Rubb ka inkaar kiya! Tujhe kis cheez ne apne Rubb ke hukm ke khilaf kar diya, jab ke us ne apne karam se tujhe mohlat di aur jald saza na di?
7: Usi ne tujhe wujood diya jab tu kuch na tha, aur tere aaza ko theek tartib aur tawazun diya.
8: Jis soorat mein us ne tujhe paida karna chaha, usi mein paida kiya. Us ne tujh par ehsan kiya ke tujhe gadhe, bandar, kutte ya kisi aur soorat mein paida na kiya.
9: Aey dhoke mein pare hue insan, maamla waisa nahin jaisa tu ne samjha! Haqeeqat yeh hai ke tu badle ke din ka inkaar karta hai aur us ke liye amal nahin karta.
10: Tum par aise farishte muqarrar hain jo tumhare aamaal likhte hain,
11: Allah ke nazdeek mukarram hain, aur tumhare aamaal likhne wale hain.
12: Jo bhi amal tum karte ho, woh usey jaante hain aur likh lete hain.
13: Jo log bhalai aur farmanbardari bakasrat karte hain, woh qayamat ke din hamesha rehne wali niyamat mein honge.
14: Jin logon ne nafarmani ki, woh us aag mein honge jo un par bharkai jayegi.
15: Woh badle ke din us mein daakhil honge aur us ki garmi bardasht karenge.
16: Woh us se kabhi gayab na honge, balke us mein hamesha rahenge.
17: Aey Rasool ﷺ, aap ko kya maloom ke insaaf ka din kya hai?
18: Phir aap ko kya maloom ke insaaf ka din kya hai?
19: Woh aisa din hai jis mein koi kisi ko faida na pahuncha sakega. Us din poora maamla sirf Allah ka hoga, woh jo chahe kare, aur us ke siwa kisi ka nahin.
